scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of a walled hilltop city encircled by earth-and-timber siege works, tents and ranks of soldiers. Workers carry earth baskets and brace timbers in the foreground. A robed royal figure and attendants watch beside a cream tent and lion banners, beneath an olive branch and blue sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The surrounding camp and curved siege wall visualize the army encamping against Jerusalem and building works all around it. The royal figure represents Nebuchadnezzar, seen from behind. The clothes, lion banners, workers' gestures and city layout are imaginative storytelling details, not a historical likeness or an archaeological reconstruction. The intact city keeps the scene at the siege's opening rather than its later destruction.
